summary: Separate task-owned changes from unrelated work before a commit
evidence: git status and worktree diff show mixed paths
approach: stage explicit paths and inspect the cached diff
avoid: git add . or git add -A in a mixed tree

summary: Create a commit from a verified index and actual task scope
evidence: git diff --cached matches the ownership classification
approach: run cached whitespace checks and relevant local tests before commit

summary: Integrate a completed feature branch into a named local target
evidence: source and target branch state plus merge intent
approach: protect dirty work merge with the local convention and verify history
avoid: infer push or merge into an unspecified protected branch

summary: Resolve merge rebase or cherry-pick conflicts from both semantic sides
evidence: conflict paths operation metadata task intent and merge base
approach: read both sides resolve narrowly test then continue

summary: Push only after explicit intent and local verification
evidence: current branch upstream commit and checks
approach: user names the remote or branch then verify the result
avoid: infer push from commit merge or ship

summary: Delete only a local branch proven merged into the intended target
evidence: merge base branch refs and cleanup request
approach: verify merged state delete one safe local branch and recheck refs
avoid: bulk delete unmerged or remote branches
